text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 2, 2022) for 25 Trudelle Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 2, 2022) for 25 Trudelle Street - Folder Number: 22 211888 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so, granted an extension of time to July 31, 2023. 2. Amended the Property Standards Order (October 2, 2022) for 25 Trudelle Street - Folder Number: 22 211888 PRS 00 IV, to include a correction of the following wording in the Required Action: "Required Action Eliminate the hazards and make all interior hand rails/guards not facilitate climbing."
